audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was given to Mel while whys[4] under it says 'your R field is lethal to a mage who can't dash out of the tentacles'. diffRating 7.5/10 also contradicted diff FAV, a 55.99% win rate over 759 games, and the mirror's grading.
audit.why: Packet chart is Mel, Skill, then Illaoi for all five later stages. The mel__illaoi mirror graded the lane HARD 6/10 from Mel's side, whose inverse is roughly 4/10 from yours.
audit.corrected: Level 6 -> Illaoi in both layers, rating 3/10 -> 6/10; diffRating 7.5/10 -> 4/10 with the difficulty prose to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere despite the whole page being keyed to 'Solar Snare's cooldown' and 'her Rebuttal cooldown'.
audit.why: Solar Snare is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s at 1000 range; Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26s — by far the longest cooldown in the lane and the one worth counting; Radiant Volley is 10/9/8/7/6s at 950. Your Harsh Lesson is a flat 4s, which is why you close on her at all.
audit.corrected: Solar Snare's 11s and range in the do's, Rebuttal's 38s in the spike and in what you want, Harsh Lesson's 4s in the mid block.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four strings (spikes[0], wants.you[0], wants.foe[1], mid) were built on Rebuttal blocking or reflecting 'the spirit projectile'. Test of Spirit carries no projectile flag in Illaoi's kit, and the mel__illaoi mirror reached the same conclusion from Mel's side: 'Rebuttal has no projectile to return; the lane is won on spacing, not on reflect.' Meanwhile Mel's actual threat — Searing Brilliance stacking Overwhelm for a Golden Eclipse execute from anywhere on the map — appeared nowhere.
audit.why: Riot's Rebuttal text does two things: reflects enemy PROJECTILES and prevents her taking damage. Only the second matters against Illaoi. Riot's passive text: Overwhelm 'can stack infinitely' and 'the stacks are consumed to execute'; Golden Eclipse strikes all marked enemies 'regardless of their distance from her'. A player watching only their health bar dies to it.
audit.corrected: Reflect claims replaced with Rebuttal's real 38s damage-immunity window; Overwhelm stacking and the global execute written into key interactions.

edits.before: With W (Harsh Lesson) you finally close the gap her ranged Q poke opens; land E (Test of Spirit) when her W (Rebuttal) block is down, since Rebuttal can deny the spirit projectile if you throw into it.
edits.after: With Harsh Lesson (4s) you close the gap her 950-range Q opens. Rebuttal is a 38s damage-immunity barrier, not an answer to tentacles — bait it, then land Test of Spirit and let the field swing.

edits.before: From Level 3 the lane swings hard to you: W dashes you into range and E grabs her whenever Rebuttal isn't up. Bait the block, then commit and bury her under tentacles.
edits.after: From Level 3 the lane swings hard to you: Harsh Lesson closes every 4s and Test of Spirit grabs her whenever Rebuttal is spent. Bait the barrier, then bury her under tentacles.

edits.before: Throw E when her W (Rebuttal) is on cooldown so it can't block the spirit
edits.after: Land E once Rebuttal is spent — that barrier is 38 seconds at rank 1

edits.before: Use W (Rebuttal) to block your E projectile and reset
edits.after: Use Rebuttal's damage immunity to blank your commit

edits.before: Her root / slow zone — sets up her combo. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Solar Snare is 11s at rank 1 and 1000 range — it roots at the centre, slows around it.

edits.before: Track Mel's Solar Snare: Her root / slow zone — sets up her combo. Dodge it. When it is down — Land E, slam the spirit.
edits.after: Searing Brilliance stacks Overwhelm on every hit and Golden Eclipse cashes it globally — watch the stacks, not your health bar.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Solar Snare and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 4/10. She owns level 1 with range; from level 3 Harsh Lesson closes and every stage after is yours.

edits.before: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7.5/10, Mel carry threat 8/10.
edits.after: Favoured lane — difficulty 4/10, Mel carry threat 8/10.

notes: The Rebuttal-blocks-your-E story ran through four separate strings and is not supported: Test of Spirit has no projectile flag, and the already-audited mel__illaoi mirror independently concluded Rebuttal has no projectile of yours to return. What Rebuttal actually does to you is prevent damage for its duration, on a 38s rank-1 cooldown — the longest timer in the lane. Whether Rebuttal's damage prevention also stops Test of Spirit being APPLIED is genuinely unknown from Riot's text; I wrote nothing either way. The mirror also declined to assert Leap of Faith untargetability from the same bad derived flag; I matched that.
